summary.text: Janie Lopez is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 37 who took office on January 10, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Janie Lopez graduated from San Benito High School in 1997.
Her career experience includes working in food service, manufacturing, retail and the mental healthcare industry, and as a school counselor.
She served as a San Benito school board trustee.
Lopez's committee assignments in the 2023-2024 legislative session were Environmental Regulation and Juvenile Justice & Family Issues.
